items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingBiFunction where the ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建 ThrowingBiFunction，其中 ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object) 方法使用给定的 exceptionWrapper 包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Lambda friendly convenience method that can be used to create a ThrowingBiFunction where the ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object) method wraps any checked exception thrown by the supplied lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: Lambda 友好的便捷方法，可用于创建 `ThrowingBiFunction`，其中 `ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object)` 方法会包装由提供的 Lambda 表达式或方法引用所抛出的任何受检异常。

items.source: Return a new ThrowingBiFunction where the ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object) method wraps any thrown checked exceptions using the given exceptionWrapper.
items.translation: 返回一个新的ThrowingBiFunction，其中ThrowingBiFunction.apply(Object, Object)方法使用给定的exceptionWrapper包装任何抛出的受检异常。

items.source: Return a new BeanInstanceSupplier instance that uses the specified generator bi-function to instantiate the underlying bean.
items.translation: 返回一个新的BeanInstanceSupplier实例，该实例使用指定的generator双函数来实例化底层 bean。

items.source: Return a composed instance supplier that first obtains the instance from this supplier and then applies the after function to obtain the result.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的实例供应器，该供应器首先从 `this` 供应器获取实例，然后应用 `after` 函数以获取结果。
